raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":861,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS station_count FROM energy.energy_station es JOIN common.station_type_dict std ON es.station_type_code = std.type_code JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON es.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.city_name = '东莞市' AND std.category = '发电' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, es.grid_connect_date, CURDATE()) > 15;"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"统计东莞市发电场站中运营超过15年的场站数量","tables":["MYSQL:energy.energy_station","MYSQL:common.station_type_dict","MYSQL:common.administrative_division"],"columns":["station_id","station_type_code","area_id","grid_connect_date","type_code","category","id","city_name"]}],"assumptions":["运营超过15年按并网日期起算，使用 TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, grid_connect_date, CURDATE()) > 15","发电场站按 station_type_dict.category = '发电' 识别","东莞市按 administrative_division.city_name = '东莞市' 识别"]}
